Local landscaping

Landscaping in Narellan, from tidy-ups to full backyard builds

Narellan blends settled family homes with newer estate pockets, and the ground changes with them. Established blocks often need mature gardens brought back to life; newer ones need the whole yard built from scratch. We do both in-house, so there is no gap where the job gets lost between trades.

One licensed local team plans levels, drainage and planting together, and quotes a fixed price after seeing your block. No call-out fee, ever.

Get your fixed-price quote

Why Narellan is different

Built for Narellan blocks

Established garden revivals

Overgrown beds, tired lawns and dated paving around Narellan and Narellan Vale, brought back with planting chosen for local heat and frost.

Reactive clay, done right

Much of Narellan sits on reactive clay. Paving gets a properly prepared base and walls get real drainage, so nothing lifts or cracks when the ground moves.

Family-yard makeovers

Practical backyards for families: durable lawn, low-fuss beds, safe levels and paving that handles kids, pets and a western Sydney summer.

props.label: Section
props.html:
FAQs

Landscaping in Narellan: your questions answered

Do you cover Narellan Vale and Harrington Park too?
Yes. We work right across the Narellan area and the neighbouring estates. If you are just outside and not sure, call 0451 267 287 and we will give you a straight answer.
Can you rework an established Narellan garden rather than start over?
Absolutely. A lot of our Narellan work is reviving established gardens: re-turfing, replanting, refreshing beds and repairing or replacing tired paving, without tearing out what still works.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to look at your job and quote it is free, every time. You only pay once you accept a fixed-price quote and we get to work.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we are a licensed contractor. We are happy to show our credentials before any work starts, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How soon can you start?
Often quickly, especially for smaller jobs and quotes. We are open 7am to 7pm, 7 days, so call 0451 267 287 and we will tell you honestly what we can do.
